My dear brothers, my dear brothers, let your message come and send it to you.
As for the merchandise and the merchandise has been deposited in my own funds.
If he does not pay (on time), he will add 1/2 shekels per mina per month as interest.
Witnesses: Aššur-ṭāb, Al-aḫum.
From Šalim-aḫum to Lā-qēpum, Ilī-ālum and Pūšu-kēn:
The debt of my merchants which you wrote to you in Kanesh.
Take care to send the merchants and send it to you and send it to me.
Dān-Aššur and Aḫušu gave him to him.
From the merchant which you wrote, send the silver and its interest.
Do not give it to me.
They will add 1/2 minas refined silver.
Let your message come to me.
